en.heroDescription: I integrate multi-omics data to explore tumor biology and uncover biomarkers of treatment response.
en.artAlt: Conceptual illustration of molecular layers converging on tumor biology. Decorative illustration, not research data.
en.artCaption: Different layers. A more complete picture.
en.highlightTitle: A multi-omics atlas of melanoma immunogenicity
en.aboutP1: I’m a bioinformatics researcher with a Ph.D. from the University of Michigan. My work brings together genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, post-translational modifications, and immunopeptidomics to make sense of cancer biology.
en.aboutP2: My research spans CPTAC cancer studies, precision oncology platforms, machine learning, and synthetic genomics. Across these areas, I’m interested in turning complex molecular data into biologically meaningful and clinically interpretable insights.
en.sourceNote: Publication status reflects the October 2026 CV. ¹ Five BGI Innovation Class students mentored.
en.researchIntro: How can we connect molecular variation to tumor behavior and therapeutic response?

zh.heroStatement:
连接多重分子层次，

zh.aboutHeading:
从解读基因组，
到理解肿瘤。
zh.aboutP1: 我是龚剑辉（Duncan），获得密歇根大学生物信息学博士学位。我的研究整合基因组、转录组、蛋白质组、翻译后修饰与免疫肽组等数据，探索肿瘤的分子特征与生物学机制。
zh.aboutP2: 我的工作涉及 CPTAC 癌症研究、精准肿瘤学分析平台、机器学习与合成基因组学。我关注如何将复杂的分子数据转化为具有生物学意义、便于临床解读的研究洞见。

title: Cancer proteogenomics
癌症蛋白基因组学
description: Led integrative analyses of CPTAC melanoma data, connecting genomic, proteomic, PTM, immune, and clinical features to tumor biology and immunogenicity.
主导 CPTAC 黑色素瘤数据的整合分析，连接基因组、蛋白质组、翻译后修饰、免疫与临床特征，探索肿瘤生物学及免疫原性。

title: Precision oncology
精准肿瘤学
description: Contributed to the Turn-key Precision Oncology (TPO) platform, supporting reproducible tumor profiling across mutations, copy-number changes, gene expression, and fusions.
参与 Turn-key Precision Oncology（TPO）平台开发，支持体细胞突变、拷贝数变异、基因表达与融合等可复现的肿瘤特征分析。

title: Machine learning for health
面向健康的机器学习
description: Built models for cfDNA-based critical illness classification, single-cell-based gestational age prediction, and HPV integration status prediction.
构建基于 cfDNA 的危重症分类模型、基于单细胞数据的孕周预测模型，以及 HPV 整合状态预测模型。

title: Synthetic genomics
合成基因组学
description: Contributed to Sc2.0 studies through synthetic chromosome validation and multi-omics analyses of genome design, fitness, and rearrangement.
参与 Sc2.0 合成酵母基因组研究，开展合成染色体验证与多组学分析，评估基因组设计、适应性及基因组重排。

title: Genome editing analysis
基因编辑计算分析
description: Analyzed CRISPR/Cas9 off-target variants and SATI-mediated gene correction, including editing efficiency and large-deletion events.
分析 CRISPR/Cas9 潜在脱靶变异及 SATI 介导的基因校正，包括编辑效率与大片段缺失事件。

title: Research software & platforms
科研软件与平台
description: Designed RiSE for laboratory resources, built TMS for synthesis workflows, and contributed to Genovo for computer-aided genome design.
设计实验资源管理系统 RiSE，开发合成制造任务管理系统 TMS，并参与基因组计算机辅助设计平台 Genovo 的开发。

title: Cancer Proteogenomics Research
癌症蛋白基因组学研究
org: MCTP · University of Michigan Medical School
MCTP · 密歇根大学医学院
detail: Cancer proteogenomics, CPTAC melanoma analyses, and the TPO platform. Research mentor: Marcin Cieslik.
开展癌症蛋白基因组学研究、CPTAC 黑色素瘤分析及 TPO 平台开发。导师：Marcin Cieslik。

title: Associate Research Scientist
副研究员
detail: Machine learning for precision health, cfDNA classification, and single-cell data modeling.
开展精准健康机器学习研究，包括 cfDNA 分类与单细胞数据建模。

title: Head of Technology Optimization Team
技术优化团队负责人
detail: Led a computational team supporting synthetic genomics, software development, and multi-omics workflows.
带领计算与技术优化团队，支持合成基因组学、软件开发与多组学研究工作流程。

title: Bioinformatics Analyst → Associate Research Scientist
生物信息分析师 → 副研究员
detail: Progressed through analyst, assistant scientist, and associate scientist roles in synthetic genomics, genome editing, and comparative genomics.
先后担任分析师、助理研究员与副研究员，参与合成基因组学、基因编辑及比较基因组学研究。

title: Mentorship
学生指导
detail: Mentored five BGI Innovation Class students during 1.5-year research training in bioinformatics, synthetic genomics, and scientific communication.
在为期一年半的科研训练中，指导 5 位华大创新班学生开展生物信息学、合成基因组学研究与学术交流。

title: Editorial & peer review service
编辑与同行评审
detail: Guest Editor, PNAS Nexus. Reviewer for Briefings in Bioinformatics, eLife, JCO Precision Oncology, iScience, PLOS Genetics, Heliyon, and PLOS ONE.
担任 PNAS Nexus 客座编辑；为 Briefings in Bioinformatics、eLife、JCO Precision Oncology、iScience、PLOS Genetics、Heliyon 和 PLOS ONE 审稿。

title: Tools & intellectual contributions
软件与知识成果
detail: Four software copyrights, one granted patent, and a contribution to the national standard for quality evaluation of synthesized genes (GB/T 37873-2019).
拥有 4 项软件著作权、1 项授权专利，并参与《合成基因质量评价通则》国家标准（GB/T 37873-2019）的制定。

title: Honors & scientific exchange
荣誉与学术交流
detail: PIBS, Tucker Fund, and Bernard Maas fellowships at Michigan; Sc2.0 poster award; presentations including AACR 2025 and scientific investigator meetings.
获得密歇根大学 PIBS、Tucker Fund 和 Bernard Maas 资助及 Sc2.0 海报奖；参与 AACR 2025 及科学研究者会议等学术交流。

profile.name: Jianhui (Duncan) Gong
center: 密歇根转化病理学中心（MCTP）

title: CPTAC melanoma atlas
CPTAC 黑色素瘤图谱
question: How do molecular layers connect to melanoma immunogenicity?
不同分子层次如何与黑色素瘤的免疫原性相联系？
contribution: Led integrative analyses connecting genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, PTM, immunopeptidomic, and clinical features.
主导整合基因组、转录组、蛋白质组、翻译后修饰、免疫肽组及临床特征的计算分析。
outcome: Contributed to a comprehensive molecular atlas of cutaneous melanoma. First-author paper in press at Cancer Discovery.
参与构建皮肤黑色素瘤的综合分子图谱。第一作者论文已被 Cancer Discovery 接收待刊。

title: Turn-key Precision Oncology
Turn-key Precision Oncology
question: How can diverse tumor alterations become interpretable molecular profiles?
如何将多种肿瘤分子变异组织为便于解读的分析结果？
contribution: Designed and implemented components for data organization and output storage across mutations, copy-number changes, structural variants, expression, and gene fusions.
设计和实现数据组织与结果存储组件，支持突变、拷贝数变异、结构变异、基因表达及融合等分析结果的管理。
outcome: Supported scalable, reproducible, and clinically interpretable tumor profiling through contributions to the TPO platform.
通过参与 TPO 平台开发，支持可扩展、可复现且便于临床解读的肿瘤分子特征分析。

title: The Synthetic Yeast Genome Project
合成酵母基因组计划
question: How does rewriting a genome change cellular function?
改写基因组会如何影响细胞功能？
contribution: Performed sequence validation and multi-omics analyses for Sc2.0 studies, including synthetic chromosomes II, XII, and XIII.
在 Sc2.0 研究中开展序列验证及多组学分析，包括合成染色体 II、XII 和 XIII。
outcome: Contributed to studies of synthetic chromosome function, genome design-associated fitness defects, and aneuploidy-related phenotypes.
参与研究合成染色体功能、基因组设计相关适应性缺陷及非整倍性相关表型。
